segs.text: He had the strongest army on earth. And he drowned in one morning.
He enslaved a whole nation and killed their sons.
Then Musa came to him with one message from Allah.
Pharaoh mocked him, and chased him to the sea. And the sea split open.
Musa crossed. Pharaoh followed. And the water closed over him.
Allah said to him: Today We will preserve your corpse so that you may become an example for those who come after you.

quote.text: Today We will preserve your corpse so that you may become an example for those who come after you.

segs.text: Power is a loan. Every Pharaoh falls.
